claims.local.cut: {place} had {amountA} budgeted for "{item}" in FY{fyA}. The FY{fyB} {draft}budget allocates nothing.
claims.local.new: {place} is allocated {amountB} for "{item}" in the FY{fyB} {draft}budget, having had nothing in FY{fyA}.
claims.local.flat: {place}'s budget for "{item}" is unchanged at {amountB} for a second year (FY{fyA} and FY{fyB}).
claims.local.up: {place}'s budget for "{item}" goes up {pct}%, from {amountA} in FY{fyA} to {amountB} in the FY{fyB} {draft}budget.
claims.local.down: {place}'s budget for "{item}" goes down {pct}%, from {amountA} in FY{fyA} to {amountB} in the FY{fyB} {draft}budget.
claims.place.cut: {place} had {amountA} under {programme} in FY{fyA}. The FY{fyB} {draft}budget allocates nothing.
claims.place.new: {place} is allocated {amountB} under {programme} in the FY{fyB} {draft}budget, having had nothing in FY{fyA}.
claims.place.flat: {place}'s budget under {programme} is unchanged at {amountB} for a second year (FY{fyA} and FY{fyB}).
claims.place.up: {place}'s budget under {programme} goes up {pct}%, from {amountA} in FY{fyA} to {amountB} in the FY{fyB} {draft}budget.
claims.place.down: {place}'s budget under {programme} goes down {pct}%, from {amountA} in FY{fyA} to {amountB} in the FY{fyB} {draft}budget.
claims.org.flat: {org} is allocated {amountB} for "{item}" under {programme} in the FY{fyB} {draft}budget, unchanged from FY{fyA}.
claims.org.new: {org} is allocated {amountB} for "{item}" under {programme} in the FY{fyB} {draft}budget, having had nothing in FY{fyA}.
claims.org.changed: {org} is allocated {amountB} for "{item}" under {programme} in the FY{fyB} {draft}budget, from {amountA} in FY{fyA}.
